user.title: ISYGLT Main Controller
user.description: Connect to the ISYGLT Modbus TCP controller.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Modbus TCP controller.

abort.already_configured: This Modbus TCP controller is already configured.

add_light.title: Add Light
add_light.description: Choose Dimmable or Switched. Dimmable automatically uses an ISYGLT M address (holding register); Switched automatically uses an NE address (coil). Modbus addressing is calculated internally.

add_switch.title: Add Switch
add_switch.description: Switch using a native ISYGLT NE address. For example, enter 12.4 for NE 12.4. The Modbus coil and protocol offset are calculated automatically.

add_cover.title: Add Cover
add_cover.description: Cover with two native ISYGLT NE addresses. Open and close send a 3-second long press. Stop sends a 200 ms short press on the same direction. Two short-press Button entities are also created.

add_climate.title: Add Climate
add_climate.description: Native ISYGLT Climate: target temperature uses M and measured temperature uses SM. Range is 10–40 °C in 1 °C steps. Enable Airco to configure NE/NA fan and power controls.

data.name: Name
data.target_temperature_address: ISYGLT M address for target temperature
data.current_temperature_address: ISYGLT SM address for measured temperature

add_scene.title: Add Scene
add_scene.description: ISYGLT scene/preset: a short pulse on NE activates the scene and NA reports the active scene. The linked Store button holds the same NE address for 5 seconds to store the current state in ISYGLT.

add_climate_airco.title: Configure Airco controls
add_climate_airco.description: Each function uses an NE pushbutton command and an NA for actual feedback. The Climate entity uses NA feedback for fan mode and Airco power state.

controller_settings.title: Controller settings
controller_settings.description: Set how often Home Assistant reads status values from this ISYGLT controller. Minimum is 0.1 second. Changing this setting reloads the integration.

error.invalid_isyglt_address: Invalid ISYGLT address. For Dimmable use for example 8 (M 8); for Switched use for example 30.3 (NE 30.3).
error.invalid_switch_address: Invalid Switch address. Use an NE group.bit address such as 1.1 or 30.3.
error.invalid_cover_address: Invalid Cover address. Use an NE group.bit address such as 20.1.
error.cover_addresses_equal: Up and down must use different NE addresses.
error.invalid_scene_trigger_address: Invalid Scene NE address. Use group.bit, for example 1.1.
error.invalid_scene_feedback_address: Invalid Scene NA feedback address. Use group.bit, for example 1.1.
error.invalid_climate_target_address: Invalid M address. For example, use 20 for M 20.
error.invalid_climate_current_address: Invalid SM address. For example, use 20 for SM 20.
error.invalid_climate_ne_address: Invalid NE address. Use group.bit, for example 10.1.
error.invalid_climate_na_address: Invalid NA address. Use group.bit, for example 10.1.
error.duplicate_climate_address: This address is already used by another Airco function of the same type.
